content.executive_summary:
- **Identity confirmed**: IRAP (Institut de Recherche en Astrophysique et Planétologie, UMR 5277) is a joint research unit of CNRS and Université Toulouse III–Paul Sabatier under triple tutelle with CNES, based at 9 avenue du Colonel Roche, 31028 Toulouse. The PEPS team ("Planets, Environments and Space Plasmas" / "Planètes, Environnements et Plasmas Spatiaux") is led by Vincent Génot with deputies Philippe Garnier and Jérémie Lasue. https://www.irap.omp.eu/en ; https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/teams/peps
- **Active funding ≥2024-01-01 in PEPS**: at least five competitively awarded projects remained active into 2024-2026 - SlowSource (ERC Consolidator, Rouillard, ended 2024-09), SERPENTINE (H2020 RIA, Plotnikov, ended 2024-06), PITHIA-NRF (H2020 INFRAIA, Marchaudon, ended 2025-03), FACOM (ANR-22-CE49-0005, André, ends 2026-03), PlanetGEM (ANR-21-CE49-0011, Toplis, ends 2025-09); plus SPEARHEAD-HE (Horizon Europe Twinning, GA 101131249) where IRAP (Rouillard) leads WP4. Source: https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/funded-projects-at-irap ; https://spearhead-he.eu/partners/irap
- **Hiring snapshot**: one CTAO-hosted PhD at IRAP Toulouse was posted 2026-05-31 with a 2026-05-31 deadline and a 2026-10-01 start - now CLOSED/historical. One ESA-funded postdoc on plasma specification models at Saturn/Uranus/Neptune (PI Quentin Nénon, co-PI Nicolas André, IRAP) was open at search time.
- **Public LinkedIn post URL**: no direct LinkedIn post URL was recovered for either posting; the CTAO IRAP PhD is mirrored on Glassdoor but not on a verified LinkedIn post.
- **Confidence**: high on identity, team leadership, and the project list (sourced from IRAP's own "Funded projects" page); high on the CTAO PhD; medium on the Nénon/André postdoc (announcement verified, exact deadline not independently confirmed in the search snapshot).
- **Gaps**: the IRAP funded-projects page does not always list award amounts; for exact EUR figures the underlying ANR / CORDIS records must be consulted. No verified direct LinkedIn post URL was located for either posting.
content.identity:
IRAP (Institut de Recherche en Astrophysique et Planétologie) is UMR 5277, jointly operated by CNRS and Université Toulouse III–Paul Sabatier, with CNES as a third tutelle. It is the only French laboratory of this name and acronym in this discipline, so the identity does not collide with a namesake. The PEPS team ("Planets, Environments and Space Plasmas" / "Planètes, Environnements et Plasmas Spatiaux") is one of IRAP's research teams; the team page lists Vincent Génot as leader and Philippe Garnier and Jérémie Lasue as deputies. The published research themes (heliophysics, planetary magnetospheres, planetary plasma environments, plasma specification models for space missions) match the description supplied in the lead record.

- IRAP institutional page: https://www.irap.omp.eu/en
- PEPS team page: https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/teams/peps
- IRAP funded projects list (PEPS-attributed): https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/funded-projects-at-irap
- SPEARHEAD-HE partner card for IRAP: https://spearhead-he.eu/partners/irap
content.recent_active_funding:
The table below captures the PEPS-attributed competitive grants that were active on or after 2024-01-01, as listed on the official IRAP funded-projects page. Award amounts are not always disclosed on the institutional page; in those cases the CORDIS (for EU projects) or ANR project page should be consulted for exact EUR figures.

| Project | Funder / Programme | PI at IRAP (PEPS) | Period | Status as of 2026-07-11 | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SlowSource | ERC Consolidator Grant (H2020) | Alexis Rouillard | 2019-04-01 to 2024-09-30 | Active through 2024-09-30; closed at grant end | ERC CoG on the origin of the slow solar wind |
| SERPENTINE | H2020-MSCA-RISE | Illya Plotnikov | 2021-01-01 to 2024-06-30 | Active through 2024-06-30; closed at grant end | Solar energetic particle platform |
| PITHIA-NRF | H2020-INFRAIA | Aurélie Marchaudon | 2021-04-01 to 2025-03-31 | Active through 2025-03-31; closed at grant end | Plasmasphere-ionosphere-thermosphere e-infrastructure |
| PlanetGEM | ANR-21-CE49-0011 | Michael Toplis | 2021-10-01 to 2025-09-30 | Active through 2025-09-30; closed at grant end | Planetary differentiation, Germanium |
| FACOM | ANR-22-CE49-0005 | Nicolas André | 2022-10-01 to 2026-03-31 | Active through 2026-03-31 | Volatiles in Galilean moons (PEPS PI: André) |
| SPEARHEAD-HE | Horizon Europe (Twinning) - GA 101131249 | Alexis Rouillard (IRAP WP4 lead) | start 2023; runs to ~2027 | Active | EU grant for high-energy particle data recalibration; IRAP is a partner |

All projects are competitively awarded research grants (ERC, H2020/Horizon-Europe, ANR) attributed to PEPS PIs at IRAP. None of these are prizes, institutional baseline funding, consortium coordination budgets, or mission budgets. The SPEARHEAD-HE grant number (101131249) is published on the project partners page; the related CORDIS record ID 101131044 was returned by one search hit and should be verified directly on CORDIS by ID.

Source for all rows: https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/funded-projects-at-irap and https://spearhead-he.eu/partners/irap
